notes: Sheet drawn with north to the LEFT (east up), so Whiteley, Earl and Brashears (east-west streets) run vertically. Names printed without suffix (WHITELEY, BRASHEARS) recorded as '... Street'; the sheet spells WHITELEY (key map WHITLEY). Colerain Av. runs from lower left to the top right corner, where it meets Brashears; between Colerain and the Miami Canal are lots only. Spring Grove Av. runs along the bottom third; south of it (lower on the sheet) are a coal yard and the B.&O.S.W. R.R., no streets. Spring Grove widens from 84' to 100' at x~4185 (centreline continuous). No streets cross the large block between Earl and Brashears (single lot lines at x~4186 and x~5167). The right strip (x>~6330, dash-dot C-D line) overlaps 601/602.
